Historical FSDL/LLM Bootcamp lectures are selected for durable ideas, not current vendor rankings or API commands. Use current supplementary docs and pin implementation versions. The OpenAI evaluation page explicitly warns that the hosted Evals product is deprecated; only its methodology is used with a local harness.

All required practicals have a local, synthetic-data route. Compact local models can still require appreciable memory, disk and time and may perform poorly. Paid providers and GPU-scale experiments are optional. If real training/inference cannot run, log the blocker and keep that milestone incomplete; mocks validate control logic, not ML capability.

Book licenses do not license datasets, pretrained weights, video media or trademarks. Before any model/dataset download, inspect the pinned model card, code/weight licenses, training-source provenance and intended-use restrictions. A permissive model-weight declaration does not establish that every training-data right has been independently cleared.

Face-related work is optional, explicit adult opt-in, local and privacy-preserving. Protect and delete templates, images, caches and manifests; keep them out of public repositories and logs. No unknown-person identification, gallery search, surveillance, demographic classification, emotion inference or employer/private biometric assets. Synthetic emblems and rendered-document quality tasks are first-class alternatives but cannot substantiate biometric-performance claims.

A quality classifier is not liveness detection. A small verifier is not secure production authentication, a NIST certification or a legal-compliance claim. Self-only face data cannot establish meaningful impostor performance. Any real-world deployment would require additional safety, privacy, security, consent and jurisdiction-specific review.

Privacy-aware engineering may deliberately diverge from a lecture's generic advice to log everything or host a public demo. Use sanitized metadata, finite retention, synthetic exports and loopback-only defaults.
